directive.quote: For each, find what now does that job in trillion-rust or trillion-workshop, use it, and move the tool one to one under tools/.

preserve: Original evidence addition, correction and retraction rules; reject duplicate or unknown refs, changes after deciding and removal of every live fact; keep only live refs in the next free seal.
allowed_deltas: This contract claims only the evidence-revision slice used by free-run. The eight decision operations already live in decisions.mjs; no second general engine is created.
banned_substitutions: Retired Worker engine, account, storage or admission JavaScript.
A second implementation of the current decision lifecycle.
Keeping free answer prose or decision state in files or persistent records.

required_mechanisms: A case needs at least one current fact
